0x00056C.en:
A giant artificial hibernation facility built under Project Ark, the species preservation plan of the <EOT Special Council>. Located underground in Africa's Kenya district, it is run by Magus, an autonomous supercomputer created by Dr. Sophia Nate. Thousands were to sleep there through the coming Aerogater invasion, but the <DC War> halted its construction.
After the war, remnant DC forces made it their base until the Kurogane's crew wrecked it. It now falls under a special Federation research institute. A twin facility, the 'Moon Cradle,' exists on the Moon.

0x000F14.en:
Grotesque beings that appeared in the Earth Sphere in New Era 187-188. Their main force, the Einst series, were enigmatic living weapons that at first waged inexplicable localized battles. Only the high-ranking Einst Regisseur and a girl named Alfimi showed clear will and intellect; their society resembled that of bees or ants.
The Einst had long existed in another dimension (Einst space), seemingly watching the real world's intelligent life. To silence humanity, which fought endlessly and disturbed the universe's calm, and create a new intelligent species, they finally tried to join Einst space to the real world and invade it.
They fought the Hagane, Kurogane, and Hiryu Custom repeatedly. In the final battle Neu Regisseur fused with the White Star into the colossal Stern Neu Regisseur, but fell to the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom; the remaining Einst then vanished as well.

0x001BA1.en: A high-level Federation body handling secrets on Meteor 3 and the Aerogaters, formed of 13 core members of the Federation Security Council and ranking above the <EOTI Organization>. It was chaired by Karl Stresemann, the Security Council's vice-chairman. Aware of the Aerogaters' might from studies of Meteor 3 and <EOT>, it deemed Bian's all-out resistance stance dangerous and monitored and obstructed him - one factor behind the <DC> revolt. All members died in the L5 Campaign, ending the body.

0x002A98.en: %A device fitted to certain <T-LINK System>-equipped machines. Officially a T-LINK auxiliary, it activates forcibly under set conditions, taking over not just telekinetic devices but machine control, fire control and generator output. The machine briefly exceeds its catalog specs while badly straining the operator's brain and the machine. Sometimes called 'a system for inducing hysterical strength,' its details are known only to a few in the <SRX Project>. One theory says it came from Ingram Prisken, once the project's central figure and an Aerogater agent; its black-boxed core defies even Dr. Kenzou Kobayashi, the T-LINK System's developer.

0x0034D6.en: A development program for assault-type humanoid mobile weapons. A twin pillar to the <SRX Project>, it builds machines that largely forgo <EOT>, per the wishes of its head, Dr. Marion Radom. Originally aimed at the Federation's next mainline unit, it now develops custom machines for ace pilots.

0x003B88.en: The conflict caused by the Aerogaters after the <DC> War, in New Era 187. Based on Neviim (codename: White Star), an automated planetoid that suddenly appeared at L5, the Aerogaters raided the Earth Sphere with insectoid mobile weapons such as the Megillot. Impressed by humanity's combat skill, they schemed to make humans their own soldiers, but lost in the final battle, Operation SRW. They were later found to be humans mentally conditioned by an unknown party - a fact kept strictly secret.

0x004EEB.en: A group from a parallel world, arriving via the transfer device 'System XN.' Once that world's Federation special-ops unit, they schemed after the <L5 Campaign>, backing the DC remnants' uprising. They sought to perfect System XN and prolong war with its mass-produced units and 'W Series' androids, but fell to the Hagane and Hiryu Custom.

0x0064BD.en: The Earth Federation's international military, built from the old-era UN Special Forces. While economics and administration remain inter-state affairs, it alone is unified globally, though each regional army keeps traits of the national forces it grew from.

0x0073E7.en:
A telekinesis sensing and amplification device developed by Dr. Kenzo Kobayashi of the <SRX Project>. It extracts 'T-Alpha Pulses,' deep brainwaves governing human thought, to control objects' motion and assist in piloting mobile weapons. It can also generate a Telekinetic Field, usable as a defensive barrier or rammed into enemy machines for damage. Amplified thought also widens the user's sixth-sense-like perception, helping detect and locate enemy units.
The system depends on the user's mental state, however, and excessive linkage severely strains the brain. Kenzo's project calls those whose T-Alpha Pulses exceed a set level 'Psychodrivers.'

0x0086D2.en: A deep brainwave governing human thought, proposed by Dr. Kenzo Kobayashi. Used to gauge Psychodriver aptitude.

0x00919B.en: A revolt in New Era 186 at the Earth Federation Army's Coatsland Base, Antarctica. The base was unveiling the Shirogane, first Space Noah-class multipurpose battle carrier, and the Granzon, a humanoid mobile weapon developed by the <EOTI Organization>. This was camouflage: in secret, peace talks were underway with extraterrestrials codenamed the 'Guests'. The terms, however, amounted to Earth's near-total capitulation, outraging many who knew the truth. During the talks Dr. Shu Shirakawa, a developer and test pilot of the Granzon, suddenly attacked the Guests' spacecraft, then turned on the Federation forces, leaving the base devastated. Negotiations collapsed, and the <DC> rose up soon after, triggering the wars that followed (the <DC War>, <L5 Campaign>, and <Inspector Incident>). As the Guests had arrived over the base in an <Aerogaters> ship, many at the time equated the two. Since the <Inspector Incident>, the prevailing view is that the ship was a decoy and the Guests are not Aerogaters but a force closely tied to the <Inspectors>.

0x009FAE.en: Pilots of humanoid mobile weapons once raised at the <School>. Kinless children with superior reflexes and dynamic vision underwent mind control, drugs, and special training. Memories were erased on entry, and severe <Limacon> destroyed many minds. Arado, Seolla, and Latooni are among the few survivors.

0x00AAFB.en: XA heavy machinery maker Tin Mao founded in New Era 176 with Yuan Meilun and others in the lunar city Celevis. It first built bipedal lunar work machines but now mainly develops and makes Personal Troopers. Its president is Tin's daughter, Ring Mao.

0x00B2E8.en: A meteorite that fell in New Era 179 on Aidoneus Island, off the Marquesas Islands in the South Pacific. <EOTI Organization> studies suggest the Aerogaters sent it to Earth deliberately: it appeared suddenly in the L5 sector before falling, decelerated on its own before impact, and held <EOT> sealed inside, packaged to be examined by others. The name follows 'Meteor 1' and 'Meteor 2,' Old Era meteorites that struck New York and Moscow and gravely set back Earth's civilization.

0x00BCA6.en: The ReEOTH PLAN. ReEOTH ('Laios') stands for 'Reliable Extra Over Technological Hybrid' - alien technology made highly dependable. The plan fundamentally reworks the unstable <EOT>, raising its reliability and stability by adding Earth's latest technology. Beyond upgrading existing EOT-equipped machines, it aims to bring ReEOTH into successors to the R-Series and future mass-production units.
